title: [Minecraft Computer Engineering] - Quad-Core Redstone Computer v5.0 [12k sub special!]
summary: A showcase of the author's fifth-generation quad-core computer built entirely from Minecraft redstone, after two years of development. It features cache, a hardware stack, a GPU driving a 15x15 display, and serial I/O ports.
why: Cited as an impressive example of a full computer architecture built inside Minecraft.

quote.text: features things like cache, hardware stack, a gpu connected to a 15x15 display, serial input and output port and many other interesting things.
